claims.claim: The new module validates a caller-supplied P1A scope and constructs the closed v1 package. It emits one semantic view and adds a latest delta view exactly when the bases differ, without changing P1A lifecycle code.

Changed paths produce ordered ADD, MODIFY, or DELETE records with supported modes, content hashes, complete source references, and deterministic textual diffs. Mode-only changes remain MODIFY records; renames appear as DELETE plus ADD. The source table contains each referenced text once.

Construction reads bound local Git objects with lazy fetching disabled and does not use worktree content or Git diff configuration. Invalid scope, unsupported material, inconsistent content, unavailable objects, and exceeded bounds raise stable material error codes.

Source hashes use exact UTF-8 bytes, and the package fingerprint covers the canonical closed package body. The pure revalidator checks fields, bounds, bindings, references, hashes, ordering, and fingerprint without Git or provider access.
